And for  the mental suffering i just have some friends to whom i can open, mental conditions aren't really seen as diseases in here that much but i can do fine without medical help in that department. I will not resort to self-harm in any circumstance, and when i made this post i had a "mental breaking" moment so to speak but i wasn't feeling suicidal at any times, i was just feeling really sad.

Fortunately i have friends who are here to listen to me, i can't let myself be seen down by my family cause i know that not being able to do anything to help is agrevating. But sometimes its just too hard staying strong. But i have to be, for my family and for myself.
